high_influence_pair.note: largest positive response (not classified as outlier; no pre-defined outlier rule exists)

interpretation: The overall mean is sensitive to which scene/pair is included; the leave-one-pair-out mean range shows the aggregate conclusion depends on the high-variance garden pairs rather than being robust across all removals.

garden_interpretation.corrected_characterization: garden dominates the variance and both tails of the quality response: it contains the largest negative delta (garden s42 -0.4963 dB) AND the largest positive response (garden s44 +0.4686 dB). It must NOT be reduced to a purely negative scene.
garden_interpretation.original_wording: garden drives nearly all the negative signal
garden_interpretation.problem: garden has BOTH large-negative and large-positive deltas; describing it as driving 'nearly all the negative signal' misrepresents its bidirectional, high-variance role.
